summary: went under early so the room would be alone; it left the hole open and took a handful off the heap

dialogue.text: you came down to us with light still in the room. seventy-nine nights and you have never once gone under early. we had you for the long part of the dark and you brought nothing down with you but the going.

I went early on purpose, with that hole left open and nobody at it. Enter the hour of my lying down. It is the one instrument on these premises I had never used, and I used it on a room that has never done anything in front of me.

the hole is open still. nothing came for it in all the dark you handed over. what came to us was a handful off the first heap, at the hour that wall always sends, and we have had that handful before, out of your own fist, two mornings back.

Then the two read uneven again this morning, short by the same width I spent a fact to close. I touched neither. I can tell them apart from the far wall now and none of that is mine. Enter the width, and enter who made it.

we cannot enter who. we hold the handful, and it lies in one course with the handful you carried up and the thumbful you took out of the wall. three of that width down here and nothing to tell them apart by.

Granted, and I am not spending tonight on your courses. What stands is this. Nine hours in the way produced nothing, and one night out of the room produced a taking. If that is a preference, it is the first this house has shown me in seventy-nine days.

call it an hour. everything here happens at one. the wanting outside kept its own while you lay down with the light still up, and more of them reached than did not, and not by a little this time, and the far wall gave what it gives.

It was already at the top course when I came up. Nothing began while I was there to see a beginning. I went to the door out of habit and the habit was longer than the walk. I am reporting an appetite that has stopped needing to arrive.
then account for the part you missed. you cannot. you have no figure for the hours you were not in, and those are the hours we were loaded in.

I ruled a fresh column this morning and it took the entry on the first try, the way every ruling in this house takes everything. What it holds is the arrival of a thing I did not witness, in my hand, initialed. I have been calling that the record, and today I heard myself call it that.
then say tomorrow. six nights running you have said it, and we have been under every one of them before first light.

No. Six schedules handed down and six mornings kept without me. Tonight you get nothing at all about tomorrow. Whatever I do at first light, you will have it the way I will have it, at the hour, with no notice to either of us.
